games.title: Block Drop
games.summary: Classic 10x20 falling tetromino matrix with rotational wall-kicks, line clearing, score scaling, and soft/hard drop.
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move and rotate, Space for hard drop, C to hold piece.

games.title: Dot Maze
games.summary: Navigate a maze collecting pellets while evading four distinct pathfinding pursuers.
games.controls: Arrow keys to turn at intersections.

games.title: Cosmic Defenders
games.summary: Defend the bottom baseline from waves of alien invaders with destructible bunkers.
games.controls: Left/Right to slide, Space to fire.

games.title: Brick Rebound
games.summary: Direct a bouncing sphere with a sliding paddle to shatter colored brick formations.
games.controls: Left/Right to move paddle, Space to launch ball.

games.title: Marble Roll
games.summary: Steer a heavy rolling marble across narrow aerial ramps, slopes, and moving obstacles.
games.controls: WASD / Analog stick for momentum, Camera follows sphere.

games.title: Cube Snake 3D
games.summary: Control an elongated snake slithering across the 6 faces of a rotating 3D cube.
games.controls: Direction keys turn snake relative to current cube surface.
